text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall-network for PRIVATE CONNECTIVITY incident in us-east-1 — multiple customer PrivateLink / DX paths seeing intermittent blackholing. See initial alerts and attachment logs.
oncall-network: Ack, on it. Canary metrics show spike in TCP RSTs to our PL endpoints in us-east-1b starting ~1747001000. I’m pulling VPN/DX tunnel metrics and NLB target health.
sam: I can confirm NLB target health for pl-ndb-prod shows 2/6 targets healthy — all unhealthy targets are in us-east-1b. CloudWatch shows increased target failed health checks (502/timeout) around same time.
anna: Customers on Direct Connect paths report inability to establish TLS sessions through their TGW->VPC->PrivateLink chain. No full region outage — other AZs (1a/1c) look healthy. Potential cross-AZ routing flap.
anna: Quick assesment: impact concentrated to PrivateLink endpoints with ENIs in us-east-1b and peering associations that prefer that AZ because of route propagation from customer TGW.
sam: Running quick inventory:
```
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=tag:aws:elasticloadbalancing:loadbalancer,Values=pl-nlb-prod --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].{id:NetworkInterfaceId,subnet:SubnetId,az:AvailabilityZone,state:Status}'
```
Result: several ENIs in us-east-1b show status "available" but not attached to NLB targets (odd).
javier: I’m seeing BGP flaps reported on the DX side from customer ASN -> our transit (ASN x.x). AWS Support case 987654321 opened. They suspect an internal fabric issue in the AZ which caused traffic to be blackholed for some ENIs. Case assigned to ENI team.
maria: Customer impact list from ops: Cust-42 (enterprise), Cust-87, Cust-kr1 — all using PrivateLink endpoints backed by our NLB in 1b. Estimated 7 customers affected, some report failed API calls and timeouts. No data corruption reported, only connection failures.
anna: Mitigation plan: 1) Drain targets in us-east-1b and force traffic to 1a/1c 2) If NLB still registers unhealthy, remove problematic ENIs and recreate in healthy subnets 3) Update endpoint policy / route propagation temporarily to prefer healthy AZs 4) Keep customers notified via CSMs.
sam: Executing step 1: deregistering targets in 1b TG target-group -> will force cross-az failover. Command:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --targets Id=i-xxxxxxx
```
(Doing this now, should see client retries hit 1a/1c)
aws-support-bot: AWS Support updated case 987654321: "Networking team confirms internal AZ fabric instability; ENIs in us-east-1b may transiently drop traffic. Mitigation: fail traffic to other AZs while internal team performs remediation."
anna: After deregister, hit ratio from DX->PrivateLink falls ~90% to healthy endpoints, error rate drops. Customers report partial restoration. Marking as partial mitigation. :thumbsup:
sam: Created an automated runbook entry to recreate ENIs in healthy subnets if they remain unavailable for >30min. Runbook snippet: 
```
# if ENI stuck
aws ec2 detach-network-interface --network-interface-id eni-abc123 || true
aws ec2 delete-network-interface --network-interface-id eni-abc123 || true
# recreate via ALB provisioning path
```
maria: Notifying CSMs and sending short incident update to affected customers: we have partial mitigation, working with AWS to fully restore AZ fabric, ETA unknown.
javier: Handoff — my oncall window ends in 20m. I’m handing to sam for continuity. Summary: AZ us-east-1b fabric instability -> PrivateLink ENIs blackholed -> drained targets to 1a/1c -> partial recovery. AWS case 987654321 ongoing. Next steps for next oncall: monitor NLB target health, verify ENI recreation logic, coordinate with AWS ticket.
oncall-network: Handoff acknowledged. Sam taking.
sam: Taking over. I’ll keep tracking and will escalate to infra if recreation fails. If ENIs are auto-recreated but still unhealthy we may need a broader traffic-shift policy (canary to us-west-2).
aws-support-bot: Update: AWS reports internal maintenance event in us-east-1 influence plane completed for impacted hosts; ENI health should stabilize over next 10-30 minutes. Please confirm.
maria: CSMs confirm: 4/7 customers reported restored connectivity, 3 still seeing intermittent timeouts. Sending follow-up notes.
sam: Monitoring — last check: NLB healthy targets 5/6, remaining failing target in 1b shows timeouts. Recreated ENI for that target group and re-registered target; initial health checks passing.
javier: Thanks team — good recovery. Leaving final postmortem notes for oncall. Please tag me if anything flares up. :white_check_mark: 
cust-success-ops: Acknowledged. We'll update customer incident pages and prepare follow-up change to prefer multi-AZ endpoints for future to reduce blast radius.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for paging; keep thread for postmortem drafting and root cause timeline.
